1.reproduce_code:
import { Nav } from '@alifd/next';

const { Item, SubNav } = Nav;

ReactDOM.render(
    <Nav style={{ width: '200px' }} iconOnly={true}>
        <Item icon="account">Navigation One</Item>
        <Item>Navigation Two</Item>  // This item lacks an icon
        <Item icon="account">Navigation Three</Item>
        <Item>Navigation Four</Item>  // This item lacks an icon
        <SubNav icon="account" label="Sub Nav">
            <Item icon="account">Item 1</Item>
            <Item>Item 2</Item>  // This item lacks an icon
        </SubNav>
    </Nav>,
    mountNode
);
1.explanation: The code sets up a Nav component in 'iconOnly' mode with some items missing icons. This reproduces the issue where items without icons appear as blank spaces in the navigation bar.
1.bug_scenario: In the 'iconOnly' mode of the Nav component, items without an icon should not appear as blank spaces. The image shows a vertical navigation bar with several items, some of which are blank because they lack icons.
